product.title: Narrated Bus Tour of Bar Harbor and Acadia National Park

description.text: Take a deep dive into Bar Harbor, Acadia National Park, and Mt. Desert Island on this half-day bus tour. Since your transportation is provided, you can focus on the scenery and taking in the insightful narrative instead of driving and directions. Stops include Cadillac Mountain, Sieur de Monts Spring, Thunder Hole. Make three stops within the town of Bar Harbor and the National Park to witness firsthand the views and wildlife that make this island so special. Ideal for visitors basing in Bar Harbor who want a guided Acadia National Park experience without coordinating park logistics, trailheads, or carriage roads on their own.
